details.report: Root causes repaired: recorded Navigator receipts now receive complete closed nested structural validation and refused defect evidence must agree with a read top-level citation; published assisted-call and Navigator schemas are closed across role/phase and primary variants and are the runtime-exported schema truth; Navigator activation now builds state locally, preflights collisions, completes the exact tool pair without exposing active state on failure, narrows fail-closed, and supports corrected activation. Rebuilt dist artifacts. Verification: npm test (403 tests, 398 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed); npm run typecheck; npm run build:recorder; npm pack --dry-run; git diff --check. No findings outside the three authorized classes were adopted.
